predicate.label: event held in place
predicate.definition: Event X takes or took place in geographic location Y.
includes: explicit event held-in or occurring-in Y
an event actually brought to or taking place in Y
excludes: a team's organizational location or ordinary person travel
a place merely bidding or competing to host X
discussion of an event in a publication
ambiguous: proposed, hoped-for, or future hosting without realization
place versus institution or event identity unresolved
predicate.notes: This requires event occurrence at the location, not only a bid or planned destination.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit event held-in or occurring-in Y; an event actually brought to or taking place in Y; historical event location. Excludes: a team's organizational location or ordinary person travel; attendance originating from Y; a place merely bidding or competing to host X; discussion of an event in a publication. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: proposed, hoped-for, or future hosting without realization; generic have/bring/lure with missing modality; place versus institution or event identity unresolved. This requires event occurrence at the location, not only a bid or planned destination.

rationale: The largest literal-role family concerns holding/bringing/bidding for Olympics in New York. Select actual event at a place, preserving A for bids/plans; Yankees geographic relocation is separate.
